name: microstore-demo
description: Demonstration web application of an online store built with a microservice architecture.

scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && ENABLE_HTTPS=true PORT=3443 API_GATEWAY_HTTPS_URL=https://localhost:4450 node server.js
scripts.start:gateway: cd api-gateway && NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 ENABLE_HTTPS=true PORT=4450 AUTH_SERVICE_URL=https://localhost:4101 PRODUCT_SERVICE_URL=https://localhost:4102 ORDER_SERVICE_URL=https://localhost:4103 node server.js
scripts.start:auth: cd services/auth-service && ENABLE_HTTPS=true PORT=4101 node server.js
scripts.start:products: cd services/product-service && ENABLE_HTTPS=true PORT=4102 node server.js
scripts.start:orders: cd services/order-service && NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 ENABLE_HTTPS=true PORT=4103 PRODUCT_SERVICE_URL=https://localhost:4102 NOTIFICATION_SERVICE_URL=https://localhost:4104 node server.js
scripts.start:notifications: cd services/notification-service && ENABLE_HTTPS=true PORT=4104 node server.js
